summary.text: Anne Dauphinais, a Republican, has represented Connecticut House District 44 since 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she lived in Killingly as of October 2019 and earned a bachelor's degree in sociology from Eastern Connecticut State University.
Her career experience includes working as a sales consultant for Novartis Pharmaceuticals, an in-home private nurse, and a pre-release case manager for the Department of Corrections.
